# WebMantu Digital

> A premium digital growth and AI automation agency based in Nagpur, Maharashtra (India). We specialize in custom website development, local SEO, and AI business automation.

## Target Industries
We have deep domain expertise in building high-performance websites, digital solutions, and automation pipelines for:
- Real Estate
- Interior Design
- Spa & Wellness
- Ayurveda Clinics & Healthcare
- Local Businesses & Premium Service Providers

## Core Services

### 1. Custom Website Development
- **URL**: /services/custom-web-dev
- **Description**: We build high-performance, custom-coded web applications using React, Tailwind CSS, and modern frameworks. Our focus is on ultra-fast loading speeds, premium UI/UX, and high conversion rates.

### 2. AI & Business Automation
- **URL**: /services/ai-automation
- **Description**: We deploy custom AI automation pipelines. We build intelligent AI chatbots, integrate WhatsApp for business workflows, and automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce overhead and improve efficiency.

### 3. SEO & Local Growth (GEO)
- **URL**: /services/seo
- **Description**: We provide traditional Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). We help local businesses rank highly on Google Maps and ensure their content is structured to be cited as a source by AI engines (like ChatGPT and Perplexity).

### 4. Website Upgradation & Improvement
- **URL**: /services/website-improvement
- **Description**: We revamp legacy websites into modern, conversion-optimized platforms with improved Core Web Vitals, responsive layouts, and aesthetic design.

### 5. Content & Video Production
- **URL**: /services/video-production
- **Description**: We offer end-to-end media production including corporate videos, promotional content, and digital media assets.
